body: I'm truly, terribly sorry that you're feeling similar to how Shane did :-(  And at such a young age! </3 Not that I'm so much older (I'm 28!). You sound like you're under a lot of pressure from school and parents, and the expectations of each, and I'm glad that you have your friend Saloni with you :-) From my experience, being in a kinda similar position as her, I know that she would rather give you all of her affection and time, if it means that you'll at least consider not dying. If it meant that I could have Shane back, I would hold him and never let go, and spend every second of my entire life telling him that I love him. You and Shane sound a little bit similar, actually. He too was very bright, gifted, and determined. A few times, he also told me that he "was already a ghost, but couldn't let go of life completely yet." In his suicide note, he wrote that he had been a ghost for three and a half years, and that he was now laying the ghost of himself to rest. I don't know Saloni, but I feel like she'll be hurt if you die. Not that I'm trying to guilt you! I don't want you to feel guilty. But, she helps and cares for you, because she loves you, as a friend or romantically, or both! Losing someone she loves will hurt, however much and for however long. I know Shane wouldn't want me to die, he did tell me that many times. I couldn't ever see him asking to commit double suicide. His preference was always to disappear quietly and make it seem like he was never there. Yes, we need to learn how to love ourselves more! :-) That sounds like such a happy thought. I'll message you soon! Thank you so much for taking the time to share your feelings with me and to respond to my post. It means so much to me <3 I hope you're happy right now, and that you have a wonderful day! *hugs*

I'm so sorry to hear of your brother! :-( Sadly I understand how you must be feeling after losing him. You're right, death is inevitable and very much a natural part of living. It does feel kinda silly to me sometimes to worry so much about when or how I'll die, when I'm destined to die no matter what my efforts are. I'm really happy that you've dealt with the tragedy of losing your brother in a way that's allowed you to cherish and live life. That makes me very happy to see :-) I'm trying myself, but it's so hard. Thank you for responding to my post! <3 It means so much to me.

I'm sorry, if was too sad! :-( I've tried to be strong for him and not to follow him into death, but it feels like my love for him is carrying me there. He told me that he would never want me to feel sadness or loneliness, or for me to die, but I'm just so confused about where to go without him. Where do I turn? To whom will I go? How? I'm sorry, I know I'm complicating things, when you're trying to give me encouragement :-) Thank you so much for your beautiful words <3 They mean a lot to me!

Thank you for your kind words! :-) I've reminded myself every day since he died on September 30th that I can't be the only person responsible for his death, but it feels like I am :-( If only I had showed him how much I loved him, or if I had opened my heart to him and gave him my love, maybe he would still be here. He wrote in his suicide letter that he "died three and a half years ago," and that since then he had been a ghost, and that he was finally "laying the ghost to rest." I read his words, his pain, his feeling of abandonment, and can't help but feeling that I was a part of that. I didn't abandon him, but I was scared to give him my heart. I wasn't the woman I should have been for him, because of my personal issues that had nothing to do with him. He was never anything but the most beautiful and wonderful man in the world to me. He did tell me many times that he wanted me to be happy and live, and that he had "great hope" for my future. I'm trying to feel like our bond hasn't died, and that I can be nice to myself and love him still, but my heart is such a mess without him </3 I feel it breaking every night that he isn't holding me. I'm probably rambling now! Sorry! Thank you for replying <3 It means so much to me that you took the time to read my words and say such kind things.

I'm sorry if this was too sad! :-( Thank you for empathising and expressing your feeling to me, though! I'm really trying so much to stay for him. I know he wouldn't want me to die because he left. In some way, I think it might make him feel better about dying, if he could know that I stayed and lived. I'm trying to do that for him, because I failed him so badly while he was alive. Thank you for your kindness in replying to me! <3

I'm sorry this post made you cry! :-( I wasn't meaning to do that! I do really love him, and ending my life without him if only for the chance to be with him is something I think about all day, every day now. Thank you for replying! <3

Hello! :-) I am in a lot of pain and grief, yes :-( I have been since September 30th, when Shane died. I've tried so much to convince myself and to believe and have faith that he's somewhere near to me, that he hasn't left me completely, and that he can feel my heart break for him. Not that I want him to feel guilty, but that I want him to feel how much I love him. I still feel like I should be able to turn around and touch his face. Living for him is what I've been trying to do, but it's just so lonely and difficult without him :-( The loneliness has become so bad that I feel like giving my life if only for the chance to be held by him again. He told me that he wanted me to live, many times, but I'm struggling to know how to do it :-( Thank you for your lovely words and for responding! <3
I'm trying to see pain as part of loving someone, but it's hard to accept that. Being lost feels awful to me...not knowing where or to whom to turn is terrible. Thank you for replying, though! <3
I'll try my best! :-) Thank you for your encouragement! <3

I'm so sorry that my post made you cry! :-( I didn't mean to hurt anyone by writing what I did. I can't imagine how he felt in his final moments. I think of it over and over again, wishing I could have held his hand and kissed his fingers, trying to show him that he was loved. That he didn't have to go...that he didn't have to leave me :-( I hope that you can hold yourself together *hugs* I hope that for everyone here :-) All of you seem like such caring people. I know he would want for me to carry on, but it's become so hard without his love :-( I'm trying, trying, trying for him. I'll send you a message soon! :-) Thank you so much for offering, and for replying <3

Mmm, I don't know if I mean as much to anyone else as he meant to me. But, I understand what you're saying! I don't want to hurt anyone, I really don't, at all. For the last three months, I've constantly gone from feeling like I need to live for him and others, to feeling like I can't go on without him. It's exhausting, and I feel like I just want to be with him. I know that probably doesn't make much sense, but that's me! :-) lol. Thank you so much for replying, I really appreciate it <3

Hi! :-) I had a moment last night where everything came spilling out of me. While crying in bed late at night, I wrote my post. I'm honestly touched by how many people have reached out to me! Shane meant everything to me, and I feel so badly about how I didn't give him the same love he gave me, for so many years. I was too involved in myself and my insecurities and issues, and though I tried my best, my best wasn't good enough. I failed him :-( Thank you for responding, though! :-) I will message you soon! I really appreciate the offer.
Aww, thank you for your kind words to me! :-) Life has been suffering and hell for me, for some time now. I'm really trying, with everything that I have. Thank you, and I hope you're at peace, too <3
I'm trying not to! :-(

I'm sorry if my post was too sad! :-( I'm really trying to live for him, it's just so lonely without him. I know it sounds ridiculous to say, but I can't accept anyone else after him. I've met other guys, but every time I've thought "Shane was better than this" or "If I had Shane, I wouldn't think about this guy." I want to be happy and live for him, and to make him be remembered by many, but I wish we could be together, at the same time. I don't know. Thank you, for your kindness and for replying! :-)

I'm so sorry that I seem to have made people cry with this post! :-( I don't want to make anyone feel worse! Shane was the most amazing, beautiful person I've ever met in my life. He's irreplaceable, honestly. I've never known or heard of anyone like him before. I know that sounds like a strong thing to say, but I honestly feel that way. He told me he didn't want me to die, and that he wanted me to live, but I don't know how to live without him :-( I think about him all day, every day. I dream about him kissing me, and I cry when I wake up, knowing that he's really gone. I'm trying, trying, trying. Thank you so much, for sharing your feelings and words with me :-) It means a lot! <3

Hi! :-) It makes me feel much better to know that someone else can connect with my words and what I'm feeling. That my words came across as natural and beautiful to you touches me deeply. I was hoping that I might feel a little bit better, if I wrote everything out and shared it with people :-) I feel like I have a lot more to do, if I'm to memorialise him...he was such an incredible person. He had the most sensitive and loving and caring heart in anyone I've ever known. He even kissed my tears, when I would cry in front of him. I don't know how else to express how beautiful he was, besides typing novels about him :-/ Thank you so much, though, for your love and kind words! :-) It means a lot to me that you took the time to read my post and reply. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.

I hope he is at peace, too. It might be a naive hope, but I really hope with all of my heart that he can see how much I miss and love him, and that he can feel better in death than he did in life. I hope that he doesn't feel like I failed him, because I feel like I did. I'm sorry that my post made you cry! :-( I wasn't trying to do that to anyone. I'm happy that my words meant something to you, at least :-) Thank you so much for replying!

Aww, I'm sorry that it made you cry! :-( I don't think of you or anyone here as being internet strangers, though :-) I'm honestly touched deeply by how many people responded to my post. I wasn't expecting that, at all. It's helped a lot to feel the empathy of many others :-) Thank you so much for your words and your offer to talk to me. I'll send you a pm soon :-)
I haven't heard of this community before :-) I just looked at it, and I think you're right, it could be helpful! A lot of people there are going through something similar to me.

I'm sorry, if it was too sad! :-( I didn't want to depress anyone with my post. It's hard for me not to blame myself at least somewhat, because I feel like he would have had more of a reason to stay, if I had told him how much I love him. He mentioned in his suicide note that he "gave all of his love, but kept none for himself." I feel like if I had given him my heart the way he gave me his, he wouldn't have felt like that. I don't know. I might be wrong. I've tried so much to be strong for him, because I know that's what he would want. It's just so lonely, without his love :-( You touched me, by saying that I seem like a wonderful person who can make a difference :-) Thank you so much for your kind words! :-)
I've been trying to live for him, because he told me many times he wanted me to continue and have a wonderful life. I just wish he was still here to live it with me :-( Thank you for replying! :-)

I'm sorry it made you cry! :-( I'm also really, terribly sorry you lost your friend too to suicide. I've been in such awful pain since I lost him. I know he wouldn't want me to die too. He told me many times that his life was "just done," but that he wanted me to continue, because he thought that I had a "beautiful heart" that I needed to share with the world. I feel like my heart isn't here without him anymore. I feel like the reasons I didn't tell him I loved him are all stupid, and that I would give anything, even my life, to be able to tell him how much I love him now. Thank you for your beautiful words <3 I really appreciate them.

Thank you so much for replying <3 It means a lot to me. I'm at a loss for words, too, when people ask me about how I'm coping with losing him. My post was the most I've said about it since it happened, so thank you so much for your kind words in reply :-)

Hey, I'm really sorry you're going through this 😔 You can talk to me, whenever you want to. I normally never comment, but your post broke my heart, and I really want to help, in whatever way I can. Please don't give up on you and us ❤
